title: Музейный разворот
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high fidelity finished WEBSITE INTERFACE design comp, a desktop browser viewport without browser chrome, landscape 16:9. This is a Russian-language interactive museum about Ancient Egypt. Show actual purposeful website layout, not a poster. Photorealistic Egyptian sandstone gateway with massive carved pillars and stone lintel, real weathering and fine carved reliefs; golden-hour Giza pyramids through its opening, warm sunset from upper right, ochre, muted terracotta, cream serif type, natural shadows and subtle dust. Egyptian architecture, no Gothic/Roman arches or classical Corinthian columns. Premium art direction, cinematic believable photography and legible intentional interface typography. At top, a quiet integrated header with small brand “ЕГИПЕТ”, navigation “Экспозиция” and “Источники”, and a small outlined sun icon. Main hero title exactly “ЕГИПЕТ”, in elegant high contrast serif, supporting line “Путешествие сквозь тысячелетия”. Modest primary action exactly “Войти в историю” with a small thin arrow. Bottom show a restrained chapter index with “01 / 07”, “Нил”, “Пирамиды”, “Фараоны”, “Письменность”, “Боги”, “Жизнь”, “Наследие”. Include a narrow glimpse of the first reading section under the hero, with tiny number “01” and title “Нил. Начало цивилизации.” on warm parchment; this is a scroll museum rather than an advertisement. Do not invent sponsors, commercial claims, statistics, fake reviews, booking forms, rounded app cards, neon light, ornamental interface grids. Stone framing and scene must be photographic, precise, not plastic or blurry. All core UI text clearly legible. No watermarks, no mockup device, no illustration brushwork. Composition B, THE MUSEUM SPREAD: The hero is a deliberate asymmetric editorial layout. Warm ivory/ochre textured reading column occupies left 32%, the full height cinematic portal and Giza panorama occupy right 68%; they feel part of one seamless museum world, no hard boxed image border. Title “ЕГИПЕТ” large elegant dark umber serif in the left column, supporting line and small arrow action underneath, generous breathing room. Photographic portal scene on right spans 87% vertical height, wide enough that the temple threshold and distant pyramids feel architectural, sunlight comes through from upper right. A slim vertical small “ДРЕВНИЙ МИР” editorial label is allowed on the separator if readable. Top header crosses whole frame, dark type on ivory and cream type over scene as appropriate. Chapter index flat across the bottom, and the bottom 13% begins parchment reading section with title left and a small Nile landscape inset right. Still an immersive portal, not a travel booking page. One dominant scene, excellent text readability and typography.
